== Reference template ==

Hello! Thanks for adding those references to the articles. In the future, though, could you use the {{tl|notes}} template instead of the section and reference tag? We combined all of that into the template so it is easier to use. Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks again! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 22:55, December 30, 2010 (UTC)
:Instead of typing in <nowiki>==Notes== <references/></nowiki> simply type in <nowiki>{{notes}}</nowiki>. [[Daved Hanlon]] should have an example at the bottom. I've been trying to convert the longer style for a while now, so some pages will still have it. Thanks! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:25, December 30, 2010 (UTC)
::If the page doesn't have any references, the "notes" template isn't required. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:01, January 6, 2011 (UTC)

== Preview button ==

Hello! In the future, could you please use the "Preview button," which is located next to the "Save page button." It allows you to see what your changes would look like before you save. It also cuts down on entries on the [[Special:RecentChanges|Recent changes page]] and reduces the workload of the servers. Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 00:45, December 30, 2010 (UTC)

== Tarabon (people) Category ==

All of that belongs on the [[Tarabon]] page. To link to a section of an article, us the "#" sign. For example, [[Tarabon#Towns/cities]] goes to that section of the Tarabon page. Let me know if you have any questions. Thanks! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 21:53, January 2, 2011 (UTC)

== Citation ==

To cite something other than a book, use {{tl|ref}}, without the "book" qualifier. Then enter in the URL after the "|". So <nowiki>{{ref|http://www.dragonmount.com/}}</nowiki> becomes {{ref|http://www.dragonmount.com/}}. Let me know if you have any other questions. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:57, January 2, 2011 (UTC) (P.S. Feel free to remove the notes section after you see it.)

== Replies ==

No worries about the verify tag. I had to go a hunt around for it. :) As for the White Tower page, it is actually not a good thing if it is copied verbatim from a book unless we are quoting it. That leads to plagiarism and so forth. How it is now is fine. Take a look at the [[Timeline]] page. It has a lot of dates listed there and is pretty accurate. The whole reason I took out the page numbers and whatnot that you had in the reference tags is because when they were listed in the notes section, they were all seperate but looks the same. The only way to see what made them different was to edit the page and look at the coding. With the new way that I showed you, and having a chapter or page number, it will look much better. That should only be used for the Guide, though. For the main series, it is fine to have just book and chapter. Let me know if you have any other questions. :) ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 23:39, January 3, 2011 (UTC)
